description: Look up one roofing contractor license by state and license number. Returns status as published by the state regulator, a machine-readable verdict (licensed-active | licensed-not-active | not-found), licensee name, city, expiration, and provenance (regulator source URL + fetch date). The verdict is derived from the regulator-published status, not a recommendation. Includes the state board's discipline record for that license (count, actions, dates, source). Use this when a user asks "is this roofing contractor licensed" or has a license number from a truck, yard sign, ad, or contract.

license_number.description: License number as printed, e.g. CCC1325838 or CGC061405; hyphens/spaces are ignored

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. FL, tx, Florida

name: check_license
